state.app: TheDoormanFallacy.com is a free public website with no login. It explains Rory Sutherland's doorman fallacy: judging a job by its most visible task, replacing that task, and losing the work nobody wrote down. It keeps a ledger of real cases where organisations reduced roles because AI or automation was to do the work, and follows what happened afterwards. Nothing on it costs money.
state.place: This website, read on a visit made for the reader's own work.
state.person: You are a reporter covering technology and work for a national business newspaper. You write several stories a week, often on deadline the same day. When a company announces job cuts linked to AI, you look for the facts, the company's own words, comparable cases elsewhere and people to quote. Your editor requires a source for every claim. Your readers are managers and employees.
